$comment: The onboarding recipe catalog of the account-delivery library: one row per recipe in every workspace a deployment that opts in creates (agent/lib/provision-workspace.ts), in this order. `satisfiesCheck` names the workspace health check the recipe turns green (app/api/ops/orgs/[id]/health). Text may write the role and record placeholders the deployment profile fills ({account}, {member}, {owner}, …).

recipes.summary: Install the starter workflow library, default apps, and crons.
